decisions.reason: A large bulk container is close to the firm's core reusable packaging range, has its own product page, and fits growing industry demand, so withdrawing it after one year is unlikely.
The valve is a component that complements the bulk-container line, has a dedicated page, and costs little to keep offering alongside the containers.

The take-back service fits the firm's move toward circular, service-based offerings, though it is only mentioned on the website, so it may be more loosely defined and somewhat more likely to be reorganized or dropped.
